wins: Maintained steady reward stream (50) by systematically chaining reconnaissance actions early in episode.
Executed consistent mentor guidance utilization across 10 calls, ensuring prompts for corrective actions were logged.
fails: Unable to translate high reward into mission success; success rate remained 0% despite episode completion.
Critical objective (exploit/payload delivery) never reached, indicating a break somewhere after initial scanning.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was reliable, but follow-on exploitation or objective triggering consistently failed, pointing to a planning gap after initial data collection.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Gaining visibility through scanning but failing to progress to checkpoint exploitation in the same episode.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When hosts respond to ICMP/ping sweep
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to targeted TCP port scan for top 20 ports

skill_cards.if_condition: When an exploitable service signature is identified
skill_cards.then_action: Reference vulnerability database and initiate prioritized exploit attempt

memory_ops.reason: High success in reconnaissance phase and consistent reward contribution
